# Bundled assets

- `gsap.min.js`: GSAP 3.14.2, distributed from the official npm package through jsDelivr. The original copyright and license notice is retained in the file. https://gsap.com/standard-license/
- `Satoshi-*.woff2`: Satoshi, by Indian Type Foundry, distributed through Fontshare for self-hosted web use. Weights: 400, 500, 700. https://www.fontshare.com/fonts/satoshi and https://www.fontshare.com/licenses
- `public-suffix-list.js`: see the source and MPL-2.0 notice in that file.

All assets are packaged locally. The extension UI makes no external font, image, or animation-library requests.
